summary: The design has a clean layout but lacks some interactive feedback and error prevention measures. Improvements can be made in visibility, consistency, and error handling.

issues.problem: The home page lacks interactive feedback or status indicators.
issues.solution: Add a loading indicator or status bar to inform users of ongoing processes.

issues.problem: The text 'Shop by Category' is not linked to any interactive elements.
issues.solution: Make 'Shop by Category' a clickable element that expands categories or navigates to a category page.

issues.problem: The rectangle has an interaction but lacks a clear label or indication of its function.
issues.solution: Add a label or icon to indicate the purpose of the interaction, such as 'View Details'.

issues.problem: The placeholder text 'Lorem ipsum' does not provide meaningful information.
issues.solution: Replace 'Lorem ipsum' with actual content that provides value to the user.

issues.problem: The button lacks hover or click feedback.
issues.solution: Implement visual feedback such as a color change or shadow effect on hover and click.

issues.problem: The navigation button does not indicate the current page.
issues.solution: Highlight the current page in the navigation bar to prevent navigation errors.

issues.problem: The FAQ section is not linked to any content.
issues.solution: Ensure the FAQ text links to a dedicated FAQ page or section.
